name: walkthrough-video-simple
description: Simple ladder for keyframed walkthrough-video export. Saves two camera views, triggers recordViewTour, and asserts the saved-views cinematic tour starts (touring='views') with the user-set pace — the recording rides the proven RecordController path and auto-downloads at tour end.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: save-two-views
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.saveCurrentView('A'); st.requestTopView?.(); st.saveCurrentView('B'); })()

steps.name: verify-two-views
steps.failMessage: expected at least two saved views

steps.name: verify-tour-started
steps.failMessage: recordViewTour did not start the saved-views cinematic tour

steps.name: verify-pace-set
steps.failMessage: view-tour pace (viewTourLegSeconds) was not set from the requested total duration
